answer_1.quote: Multi-aspect Controllable Text Generation aims to generate fluent text with a combination of attributes from diverse aspects...
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts with controlled attributes like sentiment, topic, tense, etc.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the evaluation metrics... 1) ACC i.d. and ACC comp : the averaged prediction accuracies... 2) PPL i.d. and PPL comp : perplexity... 3) Dist-3: 3-gram distinctness...

answer_4.quote: we employ three annotators to score them on the two metrics on a scale from 1 (very bad) to 5 (very good)...
answer_4.guideline: Specific scoring guidelines for relevance and fluency on a scale of 1 to 5, with detailed descriptions for each score level.
